title: Labor Schedule Clause — Warranty Joystick and Controller Replacement on Mobility Equipment
content:
# Labor on a Warranty Controller Replacement — Mobility Equipment

Summit Ridge claims from the chair manufacturer the labor of every joystick or controller replacement done under the manufacturer's electronics warranty on a Mobility Equipment chair, in whole 15-minute units, and posts that claim on the repair job. **The units claimed for a warranty controller replacement are the standard controller allowance of 3 units.**

## In minutes

3 units of 15 minutes each are 45 minutes of labor. The claim is always a whole number of units.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

The joystick module of a Group 3 Complex Rehab Power Wheelchair (K0856) fails and is replaced under the manufacturer's electronics warranty. The labor claimed from the manufacturer on that repair job is 3 units.

## Basis Q&A

**Which replacements does the clause concern?** A joystick or controller replacement done under the manufacturer's electronics warranty.

**To whom is the labor claimed?** To the chair manufacturer; the claim is posted on the repair job.
